# Loadout

> RPG-styled team meeting-load planner — drag people onto weekly meeting blocks and spot overload before it happens

- Live: https://loadout.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: meetings, workload, scheduling, team

## Your settings and your team (Neorgon Workspace)

Settings (in the header, or the `,` key) holds your time zone, working hours, work days, week start, time format and country. They live in one small cookie on neorgon.com (`neo_me`) that every Neorgon planning tool reads; it never holds a name or an email. Your people and teams live in this browser on the Workspace page, https://neorgon.com/workspace/. Loadout reads them through a hidden read-only frame (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Android) or, where browsers keep frames apart (Safari, every iOS browser), through "Load your team", a one-tap round trip to that page. Saving ("Save this board's people to your workspace") sends names only, through a review on the Workspace page, only on the visitor's click. Nothing is sent to a server. The Workspace page explains what it keeps: https://neorgon.com/workspace/ and https://neorgon.com/privacy/.

- "Add my team to Loadout" puts your team's people on the board as chips, with the colour and initials every Neorgon tool gives them.
- Your weekly hours (working hours times work days) are the week the load is measured against.
